# defectdojo_system_settings (Data Source)

Reads DefectDojo's system settings, the configuration of the whole instance. It needs a superuser. The Slack token, the Microsoft Teams webhook URL and the Jira webhook secret are left out.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "defectdojo_system_settings" "current" {}

output "jira_enabled" {
  value = data.defectdojo_system_settings.current.enable_jira
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `add_vulnerability_id_to_jira_label` (Boolean) Whether a finding's vulnerability IDs are added to the labels of its Jira issue.
- `allow_anonymous_survey_response` (Boolean) Whether anyone with a survey's link can answer it.
- `api_expose_error_details` (Boolean) Whether API errors include their details.
- `delete_duplicates` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo deletes the oldest duplicates of a finding beyond `max_dupes`.
- `disable_jira_webhook_secret` (Boolean) Whether Jira's webhook calls are accepted without the secret, which DefectDojo discourages.
- `disclaimer_notes` (String) A disclaimer shown next to the form for notes.
- `disclaimer_notifications` (String) A disclaimer added to every notification.
- `disclaimer_reports` (String) A disclaimer added to reports.
- `disclaimer_reports_forced` (Boolean) Whether the report disclaimer is added to every report, even when it isn't chosen.
- `email_from` (String) The sender address of notification mails.
- `enable_benchmark` (Boolean) Whether benchmarks, such as the OWASP ASVS, are on.
- `enable_calendar` (Boolean) Whether the calendar is on.
- `enable_checklists` (Boolean) Whether checklists are on.
- `enable_cvss3_display` (Boolean) Whether the UI shows CVSS 3 fields.
- `enable_cvss4_display` (Boolean) Whether the UI shows CVSS 4 fields.
- `enable_deduplication` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo marks new findings that match an existing finding (by endpoints, CWE and title) as duplicates.
- `enable_endpoint_metadata_import` (Boolean) Whether the import of endpoint metadata is on.
- `enable_finding_groups` (Boolean) Whether finding groups are on.
- `enable_finding_sla` (Boolean) Whether findings get SLA expiration dates. **While it is off, DefectDojo never finishes recalculating SLA dates**, so an SLA configuration whose days changed, and the products using it, stay locked (see `defectdojo_sla_configuration`).
- `enable_github` (Boolean) Whether the GitHub integration is on.
- `enable_jira` (Boolean) Whether the Jira integration is on. It is needed to push findings to Jira, not to manage `defectdojo_jira_instance` and `defectdojo_jira_project`. DefectDojo also lists the configuration permissions of Jira instances only while it is on.
- `enable_jira_web_hook` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo accepts Jira's webhook calls, which need the Jira webhook secret (`jira_webhook_secret_wo`) in their URL unless `disable_jira_webhook_secret` is on.
- `enable_mail_notifications` (Boolean) Whether notifications can be mailed (the `mail` channel of `defectdojo_notifications`).
- `enable_msteams_notifications` (Boolean) Whether notifications can go to Microsoft Teams (the `msteams` channel of `defectdojo_notifications`). It needs `msteams_url_wo`.
- `enable_notify_sla_active` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo notifies when active findings breach their SLA.
- `enable_notify_sla_active_verified` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo notifies when active, verified findings breach their SLA.
- `enable_notify_sla_exponential_backoff` (Boolean) Whether SLA breach notifications back off exponentially (after 1, 2, 4, 8 days, …) rather than coming every day.
- `enable_notify_sla_jira_only` (Boolean) Whether SLA breach notifications are sent only for findings with a Jira issue.
- `enable_product_grade` (Boolean) Whether products show a grade letter for their overall health.
- `enable_product_tag_inheritance` (Boolean) Whether every product passes its tags on to its engagements, tests and findings.
- `enable_product_tracking_files` (Boolean) Whether product tracking files are on.
- `enable_questionnaires` (Boolean) Whether questionnaires are on. DefectDojo also lists the configuration permissions of questionnaires only while it is on.
- `enable_similar_findings` (Boolean) Whether a finding's page lists similar findings, which can be slow.
- `enable_slack_notifications` (Boolean) Whether notifications can go to Slack (the `slack` channel of `defectdojo_notifications`). It needs `slack_token_wo`.
- `enable_ui_table_based_searching` (Boolean) Whether table headings also sort the current page.
- `enable_user_profile_editable` (Boolean) Whether users can edit their profiles.
- `enable_webhooks_notifications` (Boolean) Whether notifications can go to webhooks (the `webhooks` channel of `defectdojo_notifications`; see `defectdojo_notification_webhook`).
- `enforce_verified_status` (Boolean) Whether grading, Jira, metrics and reports consider only verified findings. It overrides the three `enforce_verified_status_*` settings.
- `enforce_verified_status_jira` (Boolean) Whether only verified findings are pushed to Jira.
- `enforce_verified_status_metrics` (Boolean) Whether only verified findings count in metrics, reports and filters.
- `enforce_verified_status_product_grading` (Boolean) Whether only verified findings count for a product's grade.
- `engagement_auto_close` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo closes engagements `engagement_auto_close_days` days after their end date.
- `engagement_auto_close_days` (Number) The number of days after their end date that engagements are closed when `engagement_auto_close` is on.
- `false_positive_history` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo marks a new finding as a false positive when an equal finding of the product was (experimental; doesn't work with deduplication).
- `filter_string_matching` (Boolean) Whether the UI's filters match text rather than IDs, which is faster.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the system settings.
- `install_id` (String) The UUID that identifies the DefectDojo installation.
- `jira_labels` (String) The labels of new Jira issues, separated by spaces.
- `jira_minimum_severity` (String) The lowest severity of findings that are pushed to Jira: `Critical`, `High`, `Medium`, `Low`, `Info`, or `""` for all.
- `lowercase_character_required` (Boolean) Whether users' passwords need a lowercase letter.
- `mail_notifications_to` (String) The address of system-wide notification mails.
- `max_dupes` (Number) The number of duplicates of a finding to keep when `delete_duplicates` is on; `0` deletes them all. DefectDojo can also have no limit (null), which only its UI can set.
- `maximum_password_length` (Number) The maximum length of users' passwords, 9 to 48.
- `minimum_password_length` (Number) The minimum length of users' passwords (including `defectdojo_user.password_wo`), 9 to 48, and at most `maximum_password_length`.
- `non_common_password_required` (Boolean) Whether users' passwords must not be common passwords.
- `number_character_required` (Boolean) Whether users' passwords need a digit.
- `product_grade_a` (Number) The percentage score a product needs for an A.
- `product_grade_b` (Number) The percentage score a product needs for a B.
- `product_grade_c` (Number) The percentage score a product needs for a C.
- `product_grade_d` (Number) The percentage score a product needs for a D.
- `product_grade_f` (Number) The percentage score at or below which a product gets an F.
- `read_only_mode` (Boolean) Whether DefectDojo is in read-only mode, in which it rejects every change but those of the system settings. Null before DefectDojo 3.5.100, which doesn't have it.
- `retroactive_false_positive_history` (Boolean) Whether the false positive history also marks or unmarks the existing equal findings of the product (experimental; needs `false_positive_history`).
- `risk_acceptance_form_default_days` (Number) The default number of days until a risk acceptance expires. DefectDojo can also have none (null), which only its UI can set.
- `risk_acceptance_notify_before_expiration` (Number) How many days before a risk acceptance expires DefectDojo notifies. DefectDojo can also not notify (null), which only its UI can set.
- `slack_channel` (String) The Slack channel of system-wide notifications.
- `slack_username` (String) The name DefectDojo posts to Slack as, or `""` for the bot's name.
- `special_character_required` (Boolean) Whether users' passwords need a special character.
- `team_name` (String) The name of the team.
- `uppercase_character_required` (Boolean) Whether users' passwords need an uppercase letter.
- `url_prefix` (String) The path DefectDojo is served under, when it isn't served at the root.
- `webhooks_notifications_timeout` (Number) How many seconds DefectDojo waits for a webhook to answer.
